text:
sara: Heads-up — customer (ACME Corp) filed an urgent escalation: their Private VPC deployment started returning 403 KMS errors and missing audit entries after a config change. They see high tail latency on inference requests too. cc @devon @mike :eyes:

devon: thanks. do we have their repro steps? what changed in the config? any firewall updates on their side?

sara: they said they flipped the outbound egress rule from 'allow all' to 'restricted' and added a default-deny. Error started immediately after. Repro steps from them: 1) deploy private agent, 2) lock egress to whitelist, 3) make a generate API call -> 403 from our kms proxy.

mike: can you paste the exact KMS error from the logs? 403 could mean IAM or egress blocked. also need to confirm if HSM path is used.

sara: pasted from their support bundle:
```
2026-03-16T18:12:03Z ERROR kms-proxy: request failed status=403 code=AccessDenied message="Access denied for key: projects/acme/keys/rl-priv-key"
```
They also included a note: "no audit log entries for key usage between 18:00-18:30"

irene: if egress is restricted, they need to allow our KMS endpoint IPs and also the audit-log collector endpoints. For some clouds the collector is a separate egress host.

devon: agreed. ask them to run this quick check from their VPC to confirm network reachability:
```
# from a host in their private subnet
curl -v https://kms.redwood-internal.example.com/health || true
traceroute kms.redwood-internal.example.com | tail -n +1
```

mike: also ask them to run a tcpdump on the private agent to show if TLS handshake to kms endpoint completes. sample command:
```
sudo tcpdump -i eth0 host kms.redwood-internal.example.com and port 443 -c 200 -w /tmp/kms.pcap
```

sara: I've asked for those outputs. They sent traceroute showing RST after 3 hops. Looks like firewall dropping at their edge. They say "but we allowed 443".

devon: check SNI/IP mapping. if they allowed FQDN only via proxy that can still break if our backend IPs change. advise them to allow the managed IP prefix or proxy TLS passthrough. Also confirm they aren't doing TLS interception (corporate proxy) which will break KMS signatures.

security-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1143 (priority: high) — Private VPC KMS 403s + missing audit logs. Assigned to eng-security oncall.

oncall: I'm on it. sara, can you share tenant id + agent version? i'll run a quick integrity check on our side for HSM access and audit ingestion windows.

sara: tenant=acme-prod, agent=1.4.2, deployment id=redwood-priv-42. Sent support bundle link.

mike: ran quick lookups against HSM proxy — no rate limits or denies on our end for their tenant in that window. audit ingestion shows a gap consistent with egress block (no receipts).

devon: recommended mitigation we should tell customer now: 1) temporarily open egress to kms.redwood-internal.example.com (443) or our managed IP-prefix, 2) verify no TLS-intercepting proxy, 3) re-run sample generate to confirm. If they can't open egress, set up a bastion/proxy in allowed network to relay to KMS.

sara: customer tested opening egress to our FQDN and the generate call succeeded immediately. 403s gone, audit events show up ~2m later. They want a formal postmortem and guidance doc for Private VPC firewall rules.

irene: making a short runbook: minimal egress rules for Private deployments: allow TLS (443) to kms.redwood-internal.example.com and to audits.ingest.example.com, allow our region IP-prefix (list link), permit outbound NTP and DNS. add note about no TLS MITM for KMS/HSM. I'll draft and attach to the incident.

devon: also add a short paragraph about HSM session pinning and SNI expectations so security teams know not to intercept.

mike: follow-up action items:
- eng-security: publish runbook + example iptables/security-group snippets (owner: irene)
- platform: add a validation step in Private deploy docs (agent 1.5) to detect blocked KMS (owner: devon)
- support: send customer remediation + offer help to whitelist managed prefix (owner: sara)

sara: noted. i'll draft the customer "what happened" and link the runbook. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

security-bot: INC-2026-1143 status updated -> mitigated (temporary egress opened). Pending: postmortem and runbook attachment.

oncall: closing loop once runbook published. leaving this thread open for the PM/Docs attachments.
